summary_en: 600,000 shares to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥5,360/share on 2026-08-21 morning. Estimated acquisition cost ¥3.216B. Block execution under ¥6.0B buyback authorization announced 2026-05-13.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-20, the board of Ariake Japan resolved to execute a block acquisition of 600,000 treasury shares via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition will be conducted on 2026-08-21 at 08:45 JST at the closing price of ¥5,360 per share (including final special quotations from the prior trading day), resulting in an estimated total acquisition cost of approximately ¥3.216 billion. This block execution is conducted under the authority of the ¥6.0 billion buyback program with a 1 million share upper limit announced on 2026-05-13. The order is time-limited to the specified trading window. Results will be announced immediately following the 08:45 trading conclusion. As of 2026-08-20, no shares had yet been acquired under the authorization.
